[1/5] Plan: merge-preserving prefab instance refresh, regression tests, console control, docs and full gate

impact_assessment.why: Prefab edits currently propagate to existing instances only by discarding every instance edit; keep_overrides skips overridden instances entirely, so authored per-instance values block template updates. Unity/Unreal-style propagation should update template-owned fields while retaining field-level overrides.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authors can update a prefab once and refresh every instance without losing per-instance names, transforms, assets or components; AI clients get explicit preserved/dropped override counts and one-step undo.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refresh_prefab_instances keep_overrides semantics and result keys change; dependency: none beyond the existing registry and prefab mapping; concurrency: editor actions remain under the session lock; state: undo snapshots and prefab library files must stay consistent if merge fails.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep default refresh unchanged, make merge atomic inside the existing history transaction, validate every override before mutation, add failing-first web tests for preserve/drop/undo and refresh the schema/docs/ADR.

[1/4] Plan: cumulative audit runs 1->21, 1->24, 1->27 and 1->30, fixing each finding with a regression test and pushing after each run

impact_assessment.why: The history grew from 18 to 30 commits after the first audit cycle. The next cumulative ranges are unaudited, and the newest asset-reload fix only rebinds scene and history payloads, leaving cached prefab templates and the clipboard on stale asset objects.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each range gets evidence-backed review; stale cached payloads stop leaking into inserted or refreshed prefab instances after a same-content reload.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: asset_reload report fields grow; dependency: existing registry and prefab helpers only; concurrency: editor actions stay under the session lock; state: prefab templates, clipboard, scene and history must stay identity-consistent.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Make the finding failing-first, rebind every cached payload location through one helper, keep old report keys, and run the full 6/6 gate before each push.
